title: The Design tab and every building's longer notes at your age
items: Inspect's Design tab reads at 8–10 in every year: the lines about each building's walls, roof, windows and style, and what it was built from.
In 1812, 1835 and 1904, every longer note a building's card folds behind its "why" is retold for 8–10 readers: which old map, picture or book says it, and which parts are our guess.
